state.subject: Room temperature complaints on floor 7
state.body:
Hello team,

Since Saturday, guests on floor 7 keep reporting that their rooms stay at 27-28 C
even with the thermostat set to 23 C. The AHU for that wing is running.
Could you check the optimization settings and tell us what you find? We have a
full house this weekend.

Details are in the attached photo and on our portal: [link removed]

Thanks,
Somchai
